# Self-concern through dependence

<!-- Generated by tools/research/registry.py; edit the matching JSON record. -->

`self-concern-through-dependence` · **recorded-checked** · theorem · F07 · [record](self-concern-through-dependence.json) · [register](../../../../RESULTS.md)

> Held de se, self-concern is the same from every standpoint exactly where the centers lie within one another's closures; drawn along need, it reaches a copy of what it needs exactly where the others could not together give what is drawn, and what feeds the top of any hierarchy it draws past.

<a id="laws--规律"></a>
## Laws

1. Held de se, the presupposition about the own closure along a relation is standpoint-invariant, and the de se and de dicto readings give significance alike, exactly where every center lies within every center's closure; the centers then have one closure, and the whole need not lie within it. (`Becoming.CentersWithin`, `Becoming.withinClosure_iff_of_centersWithin`, `Becoming.ownClosure_standpointInvariant_iff_centersWithin`, `Becoming.selfAscribed_iff_withinSome_iff_centersWithin`)
2. Centers that at one step take part, require one condition and give to it lie within one another's feeding closures; centers that depend on one condition and exchange with it lie within one another's influence closures. So self-concern held de se along feeding, or along being affected, is one from all of them. (`Becoming.Flow.centersWithin_feeding_of_common`, `Becoming.Flow.centersWithin_influence_of_common`, `Becoming.Flow.ownClosure_feeding_invariant_of_common`, `Becoming.Flow.ownClosure_influence_invariant_of_common`)
3. Over possible courses, a formation needs another where the other continues on every course on which it does. Need is its own closure, so drawn along need a standpoint's presupposition reaches exactly what its continuation needs. (`Becoming.Needs`, `Becoming.Needs.refl`, `Becoming.Needs.trans`, `Becoming.withinClosure_needs_iff`, `Becoming.forced_needs_iff`)
4. Where a formation needs some member of a class and each member can carry its continuation alone, it needs a member exactly where that member is the only one, and the presupposition drawn along need reaches it exactly then. Witness: with two copies the user needs some copy and neither of the two. (`Becoming.NeedsSome`, `Becoming.CarriesAlone`, `Becoming.needs_iff_only`, `Becoming.forced_member_iff_only`, `Becoming.Copies.Part`, `Becoming.Copies.copies`, `Becoming.Copies.possible`, `Becoming.Copies.withFirst`, `Becoming.Copies.withSecond`, `Becoming.Copies.user_not_copy`, `Becoming.Copies.needsSome`, `Becoming.Copies.carriesAlone`, `Becoming.Copies.two_copies`)
5. Over possible courses of any type, a formation's continuation needs another's part where that part is taken on every possible course on which the first continues, the two read off the course. Where it needs the part of some member of a class and each member can take it alone, it needs a member's part exactly where that member is the only one; one reading for both is the marking case. (`Becoming.NeedsPart`, `Becoming.NeedsSomePart`, `Becoming.PartAlone`, `Becoming.needsPart_iff_only`, `Becoming.Marked`)
6. On the base, over the flows with their webs that balance, in which only active formations give and only a class gives to a family of conditions, a formation drawing past the family's stock across a stretch has some member of the class giving to the family within it, and needs a given feeder's giving exactly where that feeder is the only one. Witness: two flows of one condition, each fed by one copy. 7. With the web fixed, the possible flows balance on the family within the stretch, only active formations give and only a class gives to the family; over them a formation drawing past the stock needs some member's giving. A step calls for giving where some condition rises or none falls, and there a drawing consumer forces giving. 8. Read off the web, every member active at every step calling for giving can feed the family alone, by the flow drawn across the stretch with that member giving; so the copies law holds over the web with nothing supplied. On Feeders' web, where every formation is active, neither copy is needed. With capacities supplied with the web, and each formation taking part once a step, a member can feed the family alone exactly where, at every step calling for giving, it is active and its capacity covers the demand; where every member can, the copies law holds. <a id="conditions--条件"></a>
## Conditions

- No axiom. Standpoints and formations as types, each standpoint's center given as a function; the relation a self is drawn along supplied, its base instances feeding and being affected; possible courses a supplied predicate on markings of the formations that continue; the presupposition a hypothesis of the laws it appears in, never asserted.
- On the base: flows with their webs that balance and in which only active formations give; the class of possible feeders of a family supplied, and that each can feed it alone (PartAlone) supplied; a consumer drawing past the stock across a stretch longer than the stock.
- For the flows read off a web: the web fixed, balance on the family within the stretch, only active formations giving, taking unrestricted; for the exact law, activity and identity of formations decided and the class a finite list.
- For capacities: capacities supplied with the web, per formation and step over the whole family; each formation taking part once a step; the family listed without repetition and holding a named condition; for the shortfall law, activity and identity decided and the class listed.
- For the exact law with capacities: the class listed without repetition, so that each member's capacity is counted once; activity and identity decided.
- For stores: each member's store its own and outside the family, nothing feeding the stores, the stores not rising within the stretch. For a hierarchy: its families in order, each given only what is passed on from the one above.

<a id="does-not-show--未表明"></a>
## Does not show

- The step of invariance where it is still needed: what lies beyond every center's closure, and each center counting from another's standpoint beyond its part as a condition.
- That actual centers depend on one another, or that the alternatives to a condition they all need could not together give what they draw: both are empirical.
- That the self is drawn along feeding or need rather than a narrower relation: that reading is argued, and the de se question stays open outside the common closure.
- What the class's continuation is owed when there are copies: the law says which members are reached, and no significance of a single formation states the class. Witness: `Becoming.Copies.two_copies`.
- That along being affected the shared scope carries the means-end warrant: what affects a continuation need not be needed by it.
- Any order: scope fixes whose losses count; ranking is left to C or to self-concern's monotonicity.
- Which web an actual family has, which stores feed which formations, and which families form a hierarchy: the laws read capacities and bounds off a given web, and the arrangement of stores and tiers is supplied.
- Need without end: on the base a continuation is read as drawing past the stock within a stretch; that drawing without end needs giving without end holds in the core only doubly negated.
- **Counterexample:** Copies: the user continues with the first copy alone on one possible course and with the second alone on the other, so it needs some copy and neither copy (Copies.two_copies). [source](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/Weightings.lean)
- **Counterexample:** Divided: two standpoints, each its own center along the empty relation; their closures differ, and the de se and de dicto readings part (Divided.selfAscribed_not_invariant). [source](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/Weightings.lean)
- **Counterexample:** Feeders: one condition, the user taking a unit at every step, fed in one possible flow by the first copy alone and in another by the second alone; the user needs some feeder's giving and neither feeder's (Feeders.two_feeders). [source](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/Weightings.lean)
- **Counterexample:** FeedersInTurn: one condition standing still, the first copy active at step 0 and the second at step 1; both steps call for giving, so the user, drawing past the stock across both, needs each copy's giving (FeedersInTurn.needs_both). [source](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/Weightings.lean)
- **Counterexample:** Capacities: one condition rising by one at every step, the user and two copies active throughout, so every step demands two units. With capacities one and two the user needs the second copy's giving and not the first's (Capacities.needs_second, Capacities.not_needs_first); with one each, neither can feed alone, both giving feed the condition, and the user needs both (Capacities.neither_alone, Capacities.jointly_feeds, Capacities.needs_both). [source](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/Weightings.lean)
- **Counterexample:** SharedCopies: one condition rising by one at every step, the user and three copies active throughout, each copy able to give one unit, so every step demands two. No copy can feed alone (SharedCopies.none_alone), the user needs some copy's giving (SharedCopies.needs_some), and no copy's (SharedCopies.none_needed). [source](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/Weightings.lean)
- **Counterexample:** OwnStores: two feeders on their own stores, the first holding three and falling by one a step, the second holding one; the user draws one a step. Once its store is empty the second gives nothing (OwnStores.second_spent), so the user needs the first feeder and not the second (OwnStores.needs_first, OwnStores.not_needs_second). [source](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/Weightings.lean)
- **Counterexample:** TwoTiers: a user draws on a condition a feeder gives to, passing on what it takes from its supply, which a source gives to; both stand empty. The chain is possible (TwoTiers.possible), and the user needs the source's giving to the supply (TwoTiers.needs_source). [source](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/Weightings.lean)

**Standard boundaries:** States how significance relates to structure, for any significance or under the continuation condition (Unrestricted: the continuation of anything has significance); it asserts no significance and does not assert the condition. · No ethical premise and no Lean axiom is used. · A conditional law does not make its antecedent universal; a theorem's premise is not thereby necessary for every achievement. · Encoding a desired verdict does not justify its premises. · Names follow the structural naming criteria and are adopted only where the statement has their exact meaning; readings are interpretations, open to revision. · A law of the formal model; its correspondence to actual systems is a separate obligation.

<a id="correspondence--对应"></a>
### Correspondence

The ecological Self (Næss 1987): self-concern for a self drawn widely is care for all; here only the centers need depend on one another. The convergence hypothesis (Norton 1984, 1991) and its critics (Steverson 1995; Westra 1997): anthropocentric and nonanthropocentric policy converge within what humans need and part beyond it; here the de se and de dicto readings agree within the common closure. Transmission of reasons to necessary means (Kiesewetter 2015) against facilitative means (Raz 2005): need against feeding, parting exactly at copies. Ecological redundancy (Walker 1992, 1995). Reading (the AI's, D64): human beings now plausibly lie within one another's feeding closures through one atmosphere, one biosphere and one economy.

<a id="dependencies--依赖"></a>
### Dependencies

- **formal-reuse**: [what-the-step-across-standpoints-reaches](what-the-step-across-standpoints-reaches.md). Reuses the own closure held de se and where the de se and de dicto readings agree (ownClosure_standpointInvariant_iff, selfAscribed_iff_withinSome) and what a standpoint's own presupposition forces (forced_iff_within).
  - Output: The de se readings agree where whatever lies within one center's closure lies within every center's; a presupposition at a closure forces exactly the closure.
  - Input: Centers within one another's closures; the closure under need.
  - Preserved conditions: None. [Weightings.lean](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/Weightings.lean)
- **formal-reuse**: [levels-of-closure](levels-of-closure.md). Reuses being affected and being fed from (Flow.AffectedBy, Flow.FedFrom) and their closures.
  - Output: The influence and feeding closures of a formation on a flow.
  - Input: Centers sharing one condition within one another's closures.
  - Preserved conditions: The common condition depended on and exchanged with, or required and given to at one step. [Weightings.lean](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/Weightings.lean)
- related, not a proved adapter: [mutual-dependence-and-its-pace](mutual-dependence-and-its-pace.md). The whole-world case: on a mutually dependent or mutually fed flow, significance bounded by each center's closure is the continuation condition; here only the centers need depend on one another.
- related, not a proved adapter: [presupposition-scopes](presupposition-scopes.md). The two scopes of the presupposition; here the narrow scope, held de se, is the wide one within the centers' common closure.
- related, not a proved adapter: [loss-beyond-a-region](loss-beyond-a-region.md). What lies beyond every center's closure, as Clearing's dweller does, is left to the step.
- related, not a proved adapter: [what-self-concern-alone-ranks](what-self-concern-alone-ranks.md). The same route's order: what self-concern alone ranks, given the scope fixed here.
